text_block_list.text: Whoa... Thank you very much, Trainer!

text_block_list.text:

than that heroine did...!
choice_data_list: Did I take a little too much?

text_block_list.text:
Not at all! That's not true at all! It 
feels like a dream come true, so I'm super 
happy!

text_block_list.text:
"Besides, if we're going to carry all 
these plushies home without dropping 
them..."

text_block_list.text:
It trains your core muscles, after all! 
It's truly killing two birds with one 
stone!
